vocs.help: The voice-of-customer statements in the order they were added, each with id, wording, source and its needs; below each need the drivers and below each driver the measurable requirements. Bulk data: unless this field is requested explicitly, reading returns only its size.

id.help: The id of the statement; the commands address it by this id.

text.help: The wording of the statement, ideally as an original quote.

source.help: Where the statement came from, e.g. a survey or a complaint; empty means no source.

needs.help: The needs behind the statement, in display order, each with id, wording and drivers.

drivers.help: The drivers of the need, in display order, each with id, wording, type and requirements.

type.help: The driver's type: ctq (quality), ctd (delivery) or ctc (cost).

requirements.help: The measurable requirements of the driver, in display order, each with id, wording, target value and measure.

target.help: The target value the requirement is checked against; empty means no target.

measure.help: The measure or measuring method; empty means none.

styles.help: The appearance of the tree: border width of the nodes and colour per kind of node.

borderWidth.help: The border width of the nodes in pixels, from 0 to 4 in steps of 0.5; default 1.

colors.help: The colour per kind of node: statement, need, the three driver types and requirement.

voc.help: Colour of the voice-of-customer statements (VoC) in the tree, as rgb(r,g,b) or rgba(r,g,b,a) with channels from 0 to 255 and an opacity from 0 to 1, e.g. rgba(230,126,34,1). The default is a strong orange. Background, border and lines of the nodes derive from this colour.

need.help: Colour of the customer needs in the tree, as rgb(r,g,b) or rgba(r,g,b,a) with channels from 0 to 255 and an opacity from 0 to 1, e.g. rgba(155,89,182,1). The default is a violet. Background, border and lines of the nodes derive from this colour.

ctq.help: Colour of the CTQ drivers (Critical to Quality) in the tree, as rgb(r,g,b) or rgba(r,g,b,a) with channels from 0 to 255 and an opacity from 0 to 1, e.g. rgba(39,174,96,1). The default is a green. Background, border and lines of the nodes derive from this colour.

ctd.help: Colour of the CTD drivers (Critical to Delivery) in the tree, as rgb(r,g,b) or rgba(r,g,b,a) with channels from 0 to 255 and an opacity from 0 to 1, e.g. rgba(41,128,185,1). The default is a blue. Background, border and lines of the nodes derive from this colour.

ctc.help: Colour of the CTC drivers (Critical to Cost) in the tree, as rgb(r,g,b) or rgba(r,g,b,a) with channels from 0 to 255 and an opacity from 0 to 1, e.g. rgba(231,76,139,1). The default is a pink. Background, border and lines of the nodes derive from this colour.

req.help: Colour of the requirements in the tree, as rgb(r,g,b) or rgba(r,g,b,a) with channels from 0 to 255 and an opacity from 0 to 1, e.g. rgba(94,88,216,1). The default is a blue violet. Background, border and lines of the nodes derive from this colour.

activeVocId.help: Which statement is shown; without a selection the first one.

addVoc.help: Adds a voice-of-customer statement and selects it.

params.text: The wording of the statement, ideally as an original quote; surrounding spaces are dropped. Empty wording is rejected.
params.source: Where the statement came from, e.g. a survey, an interview or a complaint. Empty means no source.
params.command: The command as an object with text and optionally source; it returns the id of the new statement.

updateVoc.help: Changes the wording and source of a statement.

params.vocId: The id of the statement. An unknown id is rejected.
params.text: The new wording. Empty wording is rejected.
params.source: The new source; empty clears it.
params.command: The command as an object with vocId, text and source.

removeVoc.help: Removes a statement with its whole tree. If it was selected, the first remaining one takes over. In the interface the module asks first.

params.vocId: The id of the statement. An unknown id is rejected.
params.command: The command as an object with vocId.

setActiveVoc.help: Selects the statement whose tree is shown. In the list, one click on a card is enough; without a selection the first one is shown.

params.vocId: The id of the statement; empty means no selection. An unknown id is rejected.
params.command: The command as an object with vocId; only the interface selects.

addNeed.help: Derives a customer need from a statement.

params.vocId: The id of the statement. An unknown id is rejected.
params.text: The need behind the statement, condensed and impersonal, e.g. “fast delivery”. Empty wording is rejected.
params.command: The command as an object with vocId and text; it returns the id of the new need.

updateNeed.help: Changes the wording of a need.

params.vocId: The id of the statement. An unknown id is rejected.
params.needId: The id of the need. An unknown id is rejected.
params.text: The new wording. Empty wording is rejected.
params.command: The command as an object with vocId, needId and text.

removeNeed.help: Removes a need with its drivers and requirements.

params.vocId: The id of the statement. An unknown id is rejected.
params.needId: The id of the need. An unknown id is rejected.
params.command: The command as an object with vocId and needId.

addDriver.help: Adds a CTx driver under a need.

params.vocId: The id of the statement. An unknown id is rejected.
params.needId: The id of the need. An unknown id is rejected.
params.text: The property of the process or product that serves the need, e.g. “delivery time”. Empty wording is rejected.
params.type: The driver's type: quality (ctq), delivery (ctd) or cost (ctc) — what is decisive to the customer about quality, delivery or cost (Critical to Quality, Delivery, Cost). Without one, quality.
params.command: The command as an object with vocId, needId, text and optionally type; it returns the id of the new driver.

updateDriver.help: Changes the wording and type of a driver.

params.vocId: The id of the statement. An unknown id is rejected.
params.needId: The id of the need. An unknown id is rejected.
params.drvId: The id of the driver. An unknown id is rejected.
params.text: The new wording. Empty wording is rejected.
params.type: The driver's type: quality (ctq), delivery (ctd) or cost (ctc) — what is decisive to the customer about quality, delivery or cost (Critical to Quality, Delivery, Cost).
params.command: The command as an object with vocId, needId, drvId, text and type.

removeDriver.help: Removes a driver with its requirements.

params.vocId: The id of the statement. An unknown id is rejected.
params.needId: The id of the need. An unknown id is rejected.
params.drvId: The id of the driver. An unknown id is rejected.
params.command: The command as an object with vocId, needId and drvId.

addRequirement.help: Adds a measurable requirement under a driver.

params.vocId: The id of the statement. An unknown id is rejected.
params.needId: The id of the need. An unknown id is rejected.
params.drvId: The id of the driver. An unknown id is rejected.
params.text: The measurable requirement or specification, e.g. “delivery time at most 48 hours in 95% of cases”. Empty wording is rejected.
params.target: The target value the requirement is checked against, e.g. “at most 24 hours”. Empty means no target.
params.measure: The measure or method used to check the target, e.g. “lead time in hours”. Empty means none.
params.command: The command as an object with vocId, needId, drvId, text and optionally target and measure; it returns the id of the new requirement.

updateRequirement.help: Changes the wording, target and measure of a requirement.

params.vocId: The id of the statement. An unknown id is rejected.
params.needId: The id of the need. An unknown id is rejected.
params.drvId: The id of the driver. An unknown id is rejected.
params.reqId: The id of the requirement. An unknown id is rejected.
params.text: The new wording. Empty wording is rejected.
params.target: The new target; empty clears it.
params.measure: The new measure; empty clears it.
params.command: The command as an object with vocId, needId, drvId, reqId, text, target and measure.

params.vocId: The id of the statement. An unknown id is rejected.
params.needId: The id of the need. An unknown id is rejected.
params.drvId: The id of the driver. An unknown id is rejected.
params.reqId: The id of the requirement. An unknown id is rejected.
params.command: The command as an object with vocId, needId, drvId and reqId.

reorderNodes.help: Moves a node to the place of a sibling; in the interface by dragging its badge or with the arrow keys.

params.kind: The level to move on: need, driver or req (requirement).
params.vocId: The id of the statement. An unknown id is rejected.
params.needId: The id of the need; required for drivers and requirements.
params.drvId: The id of the driver; required for requirements.
params.fromId: The id of the node to move; it must lie on that level under the same parents.
params.toId: The id of the sibling whose place it takes. The same id keeps the order and returns false.
params.command: The command as an object with kind, vocId, fromId, toId and, by level, needId and drvId; it returns true if the order changed.

topN.help: How many statements the tile lists at most, from 1 to 20.

showLegend.help: Shows the legend of the driver types CTQ, CTD and CTC below the bar.
